title: Anatomical Grounding and Leakage-Aware Multimodal Contrastive Learning for Alzheimer's Disease Classification from Structural MRI
abstract: arXiv:2609.15888v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep networks trained on structural MRI for Alzheimer's disease (AD) staging often reach reasonable accuracy while attending to anatomically irrelevant regions, and multimodal models that add clinical tables frequently rely on variables that were used to assign the diagnostic label in the first place. We study both issues with a deliberately lightweight slice-based encoder (ResNet18 with a one-layer Transformer over slices) on 1,075 baseline T1-weighted scans from ADNI-1. First, we use FastSurfer segmentations as an anatomical reference: YOLOv8 models trained on segmentation-derived labels localize Alzheimer-relevant structures with mAP_50 above 0.96, and a Grad-CAM comparison shows that the image-only classifier frequently attends to the skull, orbits and background. Second, we adapt a CLIP-style image - tabular contrastive framework and organize ADNIMERGE variables along a label-leakage spectrum. Fusion with cognitive scores yields 8

translated_title: 基于结构磁共振成像的阿尔茨海默病分类的解剖学定位与泄漏感知多模态对比学习
translated_abstract: 在结构MRI上训练的用于阿尔茨海默病（AD）分期分级的深度网络，往往在关注解剖学无关区域的情况下仍能达到合理的准确率，而加入临床表格数据的多模态模型常常依赖于当初用于确定诊断标签的变量。我们在来自ADNI-1的1,075例基线T1加权扫描上，采用刻意轻量化的基于切片的编码器（ResNet18加单层跨切片Transformer）来研究这两个问题。首先，我们使用FastSurfer分割作为解剖学参考：在分割衍生标签上训练的YOLOv8模型能以超过0.96的mAP_50定位阿尔茨海默病相关结构，且Grad-CAM对比显示仅图像分类器经常关注颅骨、眼眶和背景。其次，我们改编了CLIP风格的图像-表格对比框架，并按照标签泄漏程度对ADNIMERGE变量进行分级组织。与认知评分的融合可获得8...
tldr: 该论文针对阿尔茨海默病MRI分类中深度网络关注解剖学无关区域以及多模态模型存在标签泄漏这两大问题，提出利用FastSurfer分割进行解剖学定位验证，并构建了按标签泄漏程度分级的图像-表格对比学习框架。
en_tdlr: The paper tackles attention to anatomically irrelevant regions and label leakage in Alzheimer's disease MRI classification by leveraging FastSurfer segmentations for anatomical grounding verification and adapting a leakage-aware CLIP-style image-tabular contrastive learning framework.
